wholePhysicalScope: OpenStreetMap historic tower way 378307440 identifies Skytsborg and establishes the placement center. The measured National Park Service dimensions control the 6.096m base, 5.385m parapet and 9.601m masonry height.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the tapered masonry tower, open north arch and rooftop observatory. Closer levels add gun-port rows, stepped reveals, timber trim and roof seams.
limitations: The NPS measurements control the masonry dimensions. The mapped perimeter gives a larger envelope around the site. Exact ovoid shape, radial opening positions, timber observatory measurements and colors are estimated from the records and prints.
The dated model includes the historical wooden observatory depicted in the postcards. The original public elevation field is preserved and the exterior step contact is approximate.
